en: n. a place where people go for medical treatment or advice, often for a particular condition; a class where students learn by treating real people or cases
ex: She went to the clinic for a check-up.
她去診所做檢查。

en: n. a small room or cupboard used for storing clothes and other things; a. secret or hidden; v. to shut someone in a small private room for a private talk
ex: She hung her coat in the hall closet.
她把外套掛在玄關的壁櫥裡。

en: to provide someone with clothes; to cover something with something; (formal) to dress someone in a particular way
ex: The charity helps to feed and clothe poor families.
這個慈善機構幫助貧困家庭有飯吃、有衣穿。

en: n. a fact or piece of evidence that helps to solve a problem or mystery; a hint; v. to give someone a hint or information
ex: The police are looking for clues at the crime scene.
警方正在犯罪現場尋找線索。

en: n. a person who trains a sports team or an individual; a bus that travels long distances; a railway carriage; a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage; v. to train or teach someone
ex: The coach told the players to run faster.
教練叫球員們跑快一點。

en: n. an adult male chicken; a tap or faucet; the part of a gun that is pulled back before firing; v. to pull back the hammer of a gun; to tilt something upward
ex: The cock crowed at dawn.
公雞在黎明時啼叫。

en: n. an alcoholic drink made by mixing different drinks together; a mixture of different things; a small dish served before a meal; a. relating to a cocktail party
ex: She ordered a fruit cocktail at the bar.
她在吧台點了一杯水果雞尾酒。

en: n. a group of things that have been collected; the act of collecting something; money collected for a charity; a set of new clothes shown by a designer
ex: He has a large collection of old coins.
他收藏了大量的古錢幣。

en: a. having bright colors; full of interest and excitement; (of a person) interesting and unusual
ex: The street market was full of colorful fruits and flowers.
街頭市場擺滿了色彩繽紛的水果和花。

en: n. a tall upright post that supports a building; a regular article in a newspaper or magazine; a vertical line of numbers or text; a long line of people or vehicles; a vertical structure
ex: He writes a weekly column for the newspaper.
他為報紙寫每週專欄。

en: n. a pleasant feeling of being relaxed; a state of having enough money and living easily; someone or something that makes you feel better; v. to make someone feel less sad or worried
ex: She tried to comfort the crying child.
她試著安慰哭泣的孩子。

en: n. a punctuation mark (,) used to separate parts of a sentence or items in a list
ex: Put a comma after each item in the list.
在清單中的每個項目後面加逗號。

en: to share information, thoughts or feelings with someone; to pass an idea, feeling or disease to another person; to be connected to each other; (of rooms) to be joined by a door
ex: We communicate with our clients by email.
我們透過電子郵件與客戶溝通。

en: n. the process of comparing two or more things; a statement about how two things are similar or different; a likeness between two things
ex: There is no comparison between the two products.
這兩項產品根本沒得比。

en: to say that you are not satisfied or happy with something; to make a formal statement that something is wrong; to say that you have a pain or illness
ex: Customers complained about the long wait.
顧客抱怨等候時間太長。

en: n. a statement that you are not satisfied with something; a reason for being unhappy or angry; an illness or medical condition; a formal statement that something is wrong
ex: She made a formal complaint against the company.
她對該公司提出正式投訴。

en: n. a public performance of music by singers or musicians; agreement or cooperation between people; v. to arrange something together
ex: We bought tickets for the rock concert on Saturday.
我們買了週六搖滾演唱會的票。

en: n. the end or final part of something; a decision reached after considering something; an opinion or judgment based on evidence; the agreement of a treaty
ex: After a long discussion, they reached a conclusion.
經過長時間討論，他們得出了結論。

en: n. a solid shape with a circular base and a pointed top; an object shaped like this; the fruit of a pine tree; a crisp wafer in which ice cream is served; v. to put cones around something
ex: She ate an ice cream cone while walking in the park.
她邊在公園散步邊吃冰淇淋甜筒。

en: to join two or more things together; to be joined; to link a device to a power supply or network; to see or show a relationship between two things
ex: Please connect the printer to the computer.
請把印表機接到電腦上。

en: a. awake and able to think; noticing or realizing something; done deliberately or with intention; (of a person) caring about something
ex: The patient was conscious after the operation.
病人在手術後意識清醒。

en: a. fairly large in amount, size or importance; large enough to be noticed; (of a person) important
ex: They spent a considerable amount of money on the house.
他們在這棟房子上花了相當多的錢。

en: n. one of the large areas of land on the Earth, such as Asia or Africa; (the Continent) Europe, not including the British Isles; a. able to control your feelings and bodily functions
ex: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
亞洲是世界上最大的洲。

en: n. a person who is in charge of an organization's financial accounts; a device used to control a machine or computer; a person who directs air traffic
ex: The air traffic controller guided the plane to land safely.
空中交通管制員引導飛機安全降落。

en: a. costing a lot of money; causing great loss or damage; requiring a lot of resources
ex: Repairing the old car would be too costly.
修理這輛老車太花錢了。

en: n. a soft white substance that grows on a plant and is made into cloth and thread; thread or cloth made from this plant; v. (informal) to begin to understand or like something
ex: This shirt is made of 100 percent cotton.
這件襯衫是百分之百棉做的。

en: v. to force air out of your throat with a sudden noise; to bring up something from your throat or lungs; n. an illness that makes you cough; the sound of coughing
ex: I have a bad cough and a sore throat.
我咳得很厲害，喉嚨也痛。

en: a. able to be counted; (grammar) a noun that can be used in the plural and with a number; n. a countable noun
ex: "Book" is a countable noun, but "water" is not.
「book」是可數名詞，但「water」不是。

en: n. an area of a country or state with its own local government; (UK) one of the main divisions of Britain; (US) a division of a state
ex: He was elected sheriff of the county.
他當選為該縣的警長。

en: n. a sea creature with a hard shell, ten legs and two large claws; (informal) a bad-tempered person; a wild apple; v. to complain about something; to catch crabs
ex: We ate steamed crab at the seafood restaurant.
我們在海鮮餐廳吃了清蒸螃蟹。

en: n. a small bed for a baby that can be rocked from side to side; a place where something began; (the cradle of civilization) the place where a culture first began; v. to hold something gently; to put a baby to sleep in a cradle
ex: She rocked the cradle gently to put the baby to sleep.
她輕輕搖搖籃哄寶寶入睡。
ph: from the cradle to the grave
找比自己小很多的伴侶

en: n. a large tall bird with long legs and a long neck; a machine with a long arm for lifting heavy things; v. to stretch your neck to see something
ex: A large crane lifted the steel beam into place.
一部大型起重機把鋼樑吊到定位。

en: n. an accident in which a vehicle hits something; a sudden loud noise; a sudden failure of a computer or business; v. to hit something with a lot of force; (of a computer) to stop working suddenly; a. done very quickly
ex: The car crashed into a tree on the icy road.
車子在結冰的路上撞上了樹。

en: a. producing or using new and original ideas; relating to the ability to produce new things; involving imagination and skill
ex: She found a creative way to solve the problem.
她想出了一個創意十足的方法來解決問題。

en: n. any living thing that is not a plant, especially an animal; a person; something that has been created or invented
ex: Whales are the largest creatures in the sea.
鯨魚是海裡最大的生物。

en: n. all the people who work on a ship, aircraft or train; a group of people who work together; a team of workers; (past tense of crow) made the sound of a rooster
ex: The flight crew welcomed us on board.
機組人員歡迎我們登機。

en: n. a small jumping insect that makes a loud noise by rubbing its wings together; a team game played with a ball and a bat; (informal) fair behavior
ex: We heard crickets chirping in the garden at night.
夜裡我們聽見花園裡蟋蟀在叫。

en: n. a person who commits a crime; a. relating to crime; illegal; (informal) very bad or shameful
ex: The police arrested the criminal after a long chase.
警方經過漫長追捕後逮捕了罪犯。

en: a. (of food) hard and dry in a way that makes a noise when you bite it; pleasantly crisp; (of hair) curly
ex: The fried chicken was golden and crispy.
炸雞金黃酥脆。

en: n. a circular ornament of gold and jewels worn on the head by a king or queen; the top part of something; (the Crown) the king or queen as ruler; v. to put a crown on someone's head to officially make them a king or queen; to be the best part of something
ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
女王頭戴一頂金色王冠。
